revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal art, app-facing raster asset
Primary request: Create one standalone watercolor travel journal achievement medal for the second steps tier. It should have stronger visual contrast than the current soft first steps medal while keeping the same cozy TripPet medal system.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation.
Subject: circular paper medal base with handmade scalloped edge, delicate pencil outline, gentle cream paper texture, watercolor washes. Center elements: a winding trail path in dusty blue-gray, several clear dark sage paw-like footprints, a small peach walking ticket scrap with no markings, little leaves and route dots. No animals and no people.
Style/medium: soft watercolor travel scrapbook, hand-painted, low-saturation TripPet palette, delicate pencil linework, cozy polished mobile game collectible.
Composition/framing: centered single medal, full object visible, generous padding around medal, square composition, readable at small 62pt UI size. Footprints must be clear and darker than the pale base.
Color palette: warm cream paper base, dark muted sage footprints, dusty blue trail, pale peach ticket, small ochre dots; avoid pure #00ff00 anywhere in the subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese text, no labels, no watermark, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection. Do not create multiple medals; exactly one medal only. Keep subject fully separated from the flat green background with crisp edges.
